method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; rules in the statute's terms, exported seat questions derived from them, the commissioner's refund duty as a regulative rule; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Minnesota Statutes 2025, chapter 290 (Office of the Revisor of Statutes, retrieved 2026-10-19), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mn-stat-ch-290-2025.txt; the 2026 Regular Session's amendments are not incorporated

checks.result: 32 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings; one #TRACE left open as its expect comment says
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Full-year resident individuals: resident (290.01, subd. 7); net income from federal AGI with the Social Security subtraction (290.0132, subd. 26), the standard deduction with its limit (290.0123) or itemized deductions as one figure, and the dependent exemption (290.0121); the rate schedules (290.06, subds. 2c, 2d); the child tax credit and working family credit with their joint phaseout (290.0661, 290.0671), refundable, with the commissioner's refund duty as a regulative rule. Inflation adjustments under 270C.22 are input factors. Out: nonresidents, dependants, other credits, AMT, filing (ch. 289A not deposited).
seat: the individual Minnesota resident taxpayer (or married couple filing jointly)
